title: jacquemontia unilateralis
intro: Jacquemontia unilateralis, commonly known as sea morning glory, is a flowering plant native to the tropical and subtropical regions of the Americas. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help in reducing stress, improving sleep, and boosting the immune system. The therapeutic actions of sea morning glory include its ability to act as an antispasmodic, reducing muscle spasms and cramps, and its sedative effects, promoting relaxation and reducing anxiety. The bioactive constituents of Jacquemontia unilateralis include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and make it a valuable plant for herbal medicine.
